name: EPIC 212010119
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 13.9 solar radii and 1.49 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212010119 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 13.933153 (16th-84th percentiles 13.277735-14.503217), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212010119 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.492281 (16th-84th percentiles 1.335145-1.635337), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212010119: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4867.012 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 212010119 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3904.648438 (16th-84th percentiles 3788.515625-4009.6875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.04 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 3,905 parsecs away, 14 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.49 solar masses and 13.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,867 K at its surface.
